DOCKER CELLS, filled 2026-07-28 by scripts/arena-spring-ai-docker.sh against the REAL host services (embed :8899, Qdrant :6333, rqlite :4001) — the bounded standard MATRIX-SCHEMA.md sets for the docker form: footprint plus a smoke run per dimension, not a full correctness pass (the runner's correctness pass is native-only by design, see runner/durable.go). 14 cells ran directly, one per wire mode per lane. isolation_forgetful is recorded as a pass on the runner's own softenForgetfulRefusal rule: the adapter REJECTED the deliberately-omitted scope ("conversationId cannot be null or empty"), which is the dimension succeeding, not failing. safeguard and memory_cross_session are NOT wire modes — verified by asking the container for them and getting "unknown mode" — so their docker coverage is delivered by the qa/rag and memory cells above, exactly as the runner delivers them natively. Filling these required fixing run-docker.sh first: it forwarded no QDRANT_API_KEY, carried an uncredentialed RQLITE_URL, defaulted OPENAI_MODEL to a vendor id, and never forwarded ARENA_STUB_MODEL.
